description: MangDang's open-source robot dog: a Raspberry Pi quadruped with 12 custom servos that you assemble yourself. Dimensions, weight and battery are MangDang's published specs; the description package is Apache-2.0 (mini_pupper_ros).
name: mini-pupper

connections.label: battery rail (2S LiPo, mounted under the bottom plate)

nodes.label: 2S LiPo battery
nodes.req_label: 7.4 V nominal, 800 mAh — MangDang docs cap the servo rail below 8.4 V

nodes.label: Mini Pupper control board
nodes.req_label: Raspberry Pi host; servos connect with numbered cables

wiring.note: The documented pattern from MangDang's assembly guide and docs: the 2S battery mounts under the bottom plate and powers the control board; the twelve servos connect with numbered cables. MangDang's documentation caps the battery below 8.4 V (over 2S would fry the servos), which is why the 7.4 V nominal figure matters here. The servo feed's exact rail voltage is not specified, so that connection is never voltage-checked.
